$comment: Maps each user-visible Paychex customization (and the upstream surfaces it depends on)
to a selector VERIFIED against a live environment, not inferred from source.
verified: 'probe' = resolved by e2e/specs/probe/selectors.probe.spec.ts against n2a.
'dump'  = observed in the accessible-name enumeration against n2a.
'local' = confirmed interactively on a local instance; re-confirm on n2a before relying on it.
'no'    = still a guess; must be confirmed before a journey test relies on it.
Regenerate ground truth: gh workflow run e2e-tests.yml -f environment=n2a -f suite=probe

customizations.what: PendoInitializer wraps AuthLayout; the injector runs for the authenticated session (window.pendo queue stub + #pendo-script tag). Does NOT assert the CDN agent loaded or that pendo.isReady() is true — that would make a @paychex hard stop depend on cdn.pendo.io being reachable.
Paychex Changelog entry inside the account menu
Paychex Changelog link in the footer, beside the LibreChat version link
customizations.note: Footer also exposes a 'LibreChat v0.8.7' link — useful as a version assertion after upgrades.

customizations.what: Prompt Catalog panel entry in the side nav, and the panel it opens
customizations.note: #prompt-catalog does NOT exist. The panel is NOT its own navigation landmark — assert the searchbox instead.

customizations.what: ?promptCatalogId= resolves server-side; an unresolvable id surfaces an error toast
customizations.selector: goto('/c/new?promptCatalogId=<bogus>') -> getByRole('status') containing 'Unable to load this Prompt Catalog prompt'
customizations.note: Deterministic without a real catalog entry: a bogus id always takes the failure path. Toast copy = com_ui_prompt_catalog_insert_error.

customizations.selector: #tools-dropdown-button -> getByRole('menuitem', { name: /File Search/ }) contains 'Analyze, compare, and contrast large documents.'
customizations.note: Trigger is named 'Tools Options', NOT 'Tools'. Only File Search / Web Search / Code Interpreter use the declarative path; Skills and Artifacts render custom submenus and have no description BY DESIGN — do not assert one for them. data-testid='tools-menu-skills' exists on the Skills item.

customizations.what: Attach-file menu items render helper descriptions
customizations.selector: #attach-file-menu-button -> getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Upload Image/ }) contains 'Add an image for analysis.'
customizations.note: Do NOT locate the trigger by /attach file/i — it also matches the 'Attach Files' nav panel and trips strict mode. Visible items depend on enabled capabilities; locally only Upload Image + Upload as Text appear.

customizations.what: Star + DEFAULT badge on the model spec flagged default:true
customizations.selector: GET /api/config -> modelSpecs.list.find(s => s.default) -> open its group/endpoint submenu -> option(spec.label) contains getByLabel('Default model')
customizations.note: Which spec is default comes from /api/config, NOT hardcoded - a model or endpoint rename must not read as a Paychex regression. Badge lives in the ENDPOINT SUBMENU when preset.endpoint maps to a rendered endpoint (top level shows endpoints only), in a CUSTOM GROUP submenu when spec.group is set, otherwise at top level; submenus mount lazily, so the badge is not in the DOM until opened. Search results do NOT render the badge (SearchResults.tsx has its own markup), so the search box cannot be used to shortcut navigation. Badge renders the star and DEFAULT inside ONE span, so getByText('DEFAULT', {exact:true}) can never match; use the 'Default model' accessible name.

upstreamSurfaces.note: data-testid='nav' does NOT exist in v0.8.7.
v0.8.7 renamed this; the old navigation landmark 'Controls' is gone.
Disabled while the composer is empty — assert enabled only after typing.
New in v0.8.7 and live on n2a. #skills does not exist.

outOfScope.what: RAG / File Search document upload round-trip
outOfScope.reason: Not reachable from the chat composer. Enumerated on n2a (run 33502080397): the attach-file menu offers ONLY 'Upload Image' and 'Upload as Text'. File Search upload is exposed only for agents that enable the file_search capability, inside Agent Builder.
outOfScope.revisitIf: The composer starts offering a File Search upload option, or a deploy gate for Agent Builder file_search is wanted (note: that would create persistent agent data in the target environment).

localVsDeployedDifferences: Local exposes no 'MCP Servers' composer button (no MCP servers configured in librechat.yaml); n2a does.
Local attach-file menu shows only Upload Image + Upload as Text; n2a may show more depending on enabled capabilities.
A first-login onboarding dialog ('Meet the Prompt Catalog') can overlay the UI and suppresses accessible names until dismissed.
